full_page.content:
c. 1939
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten message by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap. ( Written in 3 volumes of the "Mystical City of God") TO: MOTHER AND FATHER
Dear Reader: --
If "To know is to appreciate" . Why not study more about Heaven than we do? This book introduces Heaven's Queen -- Mary Immaculate. Learn to know her . . to love heavenly things.
Fr. Solanus Casey, O. M. Cap.
Copied from: Book - City of God Used by: Fr. Solanus Now in Guild Office files Book No. 2
Dear Reader: --
"To know is to appreciate". God himself is loved -- appreciated -- only insofar as He is known. . . . We can know God through His works and by His grace.
The following pages offer a practical introduction to God's most outstanding work -- most outstanding masterpiece --
His own Immaculate Virgin Mother Mary.
Fr. Solanus Casey, O. M. Cap.
Copied from: Book -- City of God Volumes used by Father Solanus Now in Guild Office files Book No. 3
Dear Friend:
Before Reading from this wonderful book, beg the Holy Spirit -- for yourself and all -- to enlighten our minds and guide us to properly appreciate inspired writings.
Please return this book to the Monastery office St. Boneventure Monastery 1740 Mt. Elliott Ave. Detroit, Mich. inside of three or four months. Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
Copied from: Book - City of God Volumes used by Father Solanus Now in Guild Office files Book No. 4
